architecture: LowFormer-E2 (2026 IJCV hybrid CNN-attention backbone, 21.15M params without 1000-class head)
feature: official timm num_classes=0 pooled pre-logits embedding (1600D)
preprocessing: official timm pretrained config: bicubic resize, crop_pct=0.95 center crop to 224x224, ImageNet mean/std
selection_protocol: per-sample L2 normalization, train-only 5-fold C selection, LinearSVC refit on 434 train images, one validation evaluation
notes: 2026 IJCV ImageNet-1K supervised lightweight hybrid backbone (DOI:10.1007/s11263-026-02873-5). Feature extraction runs in isolated .venv-lowformer (timm 1.0.31); downstream LinearSVC validation and locked test run in the main .conda-env (scikit-learn 1.9.1).
